summary: A constructed language designed before the text: 690 roots in eleven fields of meaning, prefixes and endings continued by the pen rather than bolted on, 41 particles, two registers with fixed sound laws, a title formula at paragraph openings, each page written about the subject its section pictures, lines filled to the margin. Practice evaluation: 12 of 22. It reproduces F-014 (0.798 against the floor 0.667) -- the one fact my meaningless procedure at 19/22 cannot get, because inflection re-makes a repeated word -- and loses the glyph-level facts the meaningless procedure gets (F-013 2.77 against 2.03, F-002, F-005, F-007, F-010, F-016): a text whose words are looked up in a dictionary cannot have a hand's glyph stream. F-011 and F-020 are missed by both.
